WITH top_format AS (
  SELECT format
  FROM legalities
  WHERE status = 'Banned'
  GROUP BY format
  ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT legalities.format, cards.name
FROM legalities
JOIN cards ON legalities.uuid = cards.uuid
JOIN top_format ON legalities.format = top_format.format
WHERE legalities.status = 'Banned'
ORDER BY cards.name;

WITH banned_counts AS (
  SELECT format, COUNT(*) AS banned_count
  FROM legalities
  WHERE status = 'Banned'
  GROUP BY format
),
top_formats AS (
  SELECT format
  FROM banned_counts
  WHERE banned_count = (SELECT MAX(banned_count) FROM banned_counts)
)
SELECT DISTINCT l.format, c.name
FROM legalities AS l
JOIN cards AS c ON c.uuid = l.uuid
JOIN top_formats AS tf ON tf.format = l.format
WHERE l.status = 'Banned'
ORDER BY l.format, c.name;

JOIN results AS res ON d.driverId = res.driverId

ORDER BY r.year, r.round, r.raceId
LIMIT 1;

  HAVING COUNT(*) = (

      SELECT COUNT(*) AS banned_count
      FROM legalities
      WHERE status = 'Banned'
      GROUP BY format
    ) AS counts
  )
);

WITH banned_counts AS (
  SELECT format, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM legalities
  WHERE status = 'Banned'
  GROUP BY format
),
max_banned AS (
  SELECT MAX(cnt) AS max_cnt
  FROM banned_counts
)
SELECT DISTINCT l.format, c.name
FROM legalities AS l
JOIN cards AS c ON l.uuid = c.uuid
JOIN banned_counts AS b ON b.format = l.format
JOIN max_banned AS m ON b.cnt = m.max_cnt
WHERE l.status = 'Banned'
ORDER BY l.format, c.name;

  WHERE status = 'Banned'

```sql
  WHERE banned_count = (SELECT MAX(banned_count) FROM banned_counts)
```

```sql
JOIN races ON lapTimes.raceId = races.raceId
JOIN circuits ON races.circuitId = circuits.circuitId
WHERE circuits.name = 'Austrian Grand Prix Circuit';
```

```sql
SELECT T1.time
FROM lapTimes AS T1
JOIN races AS T2 ON T1.raceId = T2.raceId
JOIN circuits AS T3 ON T2.circuitId = T3.circuitId
WHERE T3.name = 'Austrian Grand Prix Circuit'
ORDER BY T1.milliseconds ASC
LIMIT 1;
```

```sql
SELECT
  lt.time
FROM lapTimes AS lt
JOIN races AS r
  ON lt.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN circuits AS c
  ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
WHERE
  c.name = 'Austrian Grand Prix Circuit'
ORDER BY
  lt.milliseconds ASC
LIMIT 1;
```
